title: LAOUSMAIL Fan Reactions
description: Curated public fan comments for the Fan Reactions section. Use only real exported comments selected for display.

updatedAt.description: When this curated file was last edited.

notes.description: Internal curation notes (not shown on the site).

id.description: Stable unique id (usually the export comment id).

displayName.description: Optional display name from the export.

profileImageUrl.description: HTTPS profile image from the export, or a relative path to a permitted local asset (e.g. avatars/user.jpg). May expire if remote.

postUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the original public post when known.

featured.description: When true, prefer this reaction in the featured strip.
